title: System 7.1 (Quadra, as IIci)
note: System 7.1 for the Quadra 650 as Apple's Installer made it (os-7.1: the generic System with System Enabler 040), 68k only. Boots with --model-id 5 (the base's "args"; the web UI's 68k-7.1 profile sets it): with the Quadra's model ID 14 it bombs at boot. No BridgeAgent: 7.1 has no File System Manager, so no Host volume.
